environment.description: Go WebSocket service deployed on EC2 behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TLS termination at the instance level. No WAF or application-layer filtering is configured. The service is directly accessible on port 8080 via the NLB's TCP passthrough. DNS resolves *.example.com via Route53 with no DNSSEC. The service runs in a public subnet with security group allowing inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0.

config.tls: terminated at application level with self-signed cert in dev
